title: 第909章 我就是来杀王家的人第908章 大夏皇朝
content_zh:
黑雾深渊外。
王家十几名高手，依然身处于先前苏辰和洛雪儿逃入其中时的位置，一个多月来寸步未离。
被黑雾深渊中森然的怨戾气息，近距离熏陶了整整一个月之久，让他们或多或少都受到影响，一个个面露痛苦之色。
而王玄戾身处最近的位置，两眼死死盯着下方的无尽深渊，眼中充满近乎扭曲的疯狂杀意，也不知是对苏辰和洛雪儿的憎恨太过浓烈，还是被怨戾气息侵蚀心神导致。
看着王玄戾这杀气腾腾的身影，王家一众队长面面相觑，一个个满脸无奈，却又不知所措。
经过这一个多月的时间，他们愈发确认一件事。
那就是，长老很有可能是疯了。
虽然一个唾手可得的天阴绝凰体就这么白白失之交臂，确实非常令人惋惜，但也不至于将长老刺激到这般地步吧？
进入黑雾深渊的人，绝不可能活着出来，这是整个中州连三岁小孩都明白的道理。
长老都已经在这里守了一个月，却仍不死心，根本没有带着他们离开的意思。
就这么一直守下去，什么时候才是个头儿？
两名队长忍不住凑上前，小心翼翼道：“长老，要不我们……撤吧？”
“是啊，我们都已经在这里守了一个月，就算那两人真的有能力从黑雾深渊逃脱，整整一个月过去，肯定也早已就被黑雾腐蚀得连骨头都不剩，咱们就算在这里守上再久，也没有任何意义……”
王玄戾却仿佛根本没有听到两人的话似的，两眼依然死死盯着下方的黑雾深渊，眼神虽然近乎扭曲，却又透着一股病态的执着。
他心中的预感非常强烈，那个苏辰暂且不论，但天阴绝凰体作为千年不遇的罕见体质，绝不可能这么轻易就死在黑雾深渊中。
更重要的是，除了洛雪儿体内的元阴之外，他此生此世恐怕都再找不到能瞬间突破三个级别元力的方法。
如果错过这个机会，自己这辈子就真的将被困死在七级武圣的境界，不可能再有半点冲击武帝之境的机会，王玄戾如何肯善罢甘休？
……
苏辰将雪儿收入天机宝玉空间之中，旋即运转元力，施展《匿影隐龙诀》，瞬间让自己的容貌、身段和气息，都发生天翻地覆的巨变。
王玄戾和王家这些队长，都知道洛雪儿天阴绝凰体的秘密。

因此，为了保护雪儿，也为了保护自己，他们都必须得死。
但是，苏辰也明白，他绝不能用自己的身份杀死这些人。
中州的顶级势力，拥有魂牌这种特殊的传递情报途径，王玄戾作为王家长老，肯定还掌握着除了魂牌之外的其他手段。
现如今，王玄戾为了将洛雪儿占为己有，肯定没有将洛雪儿身负天阴绝凰体的秘密传回给王家。
但是，如果自己以真实身份冲出去将他们斩杀的话，一旦被他们将消息传递回去，便会更加麻烦不断。
苏辰一时也不知该伪装成何人，索性易容成先前任天绝的样子，境界也伪装成八级武圣的级别。
确认伪装得滴水不漏后，才朝着王家众人所在之处冲了过去，眼中流露出凛然的杀意。
“嗯？有人来了！”
苏辰“八级武圣”
的气势完全爆发，快速飞来，当然引起了王玄戾等人的注意。
“气势这么强，是一个八级武圣！”
content_en:
Outside the black mist abyss.
More than a dozen masters from the Wang family are still in the same position as when Su Chen and Luo Xueer escaped, and have not left for more than a month.
They were all influenced to a greater or lesser extent by the aura of resentment in the black mist abyss at close range for a whole month, and all of them showed signs of pain.
Wang Xuanli was in the nearest position, staring at the endless abyss below. His eyes were filled with an almost twisted and crazy murderous intention. It was not known whether it was because of his strong hatred for Su Chen and Luo Xueer, or because his mind was eroded by the aura of resentment.
Seeing Wang Xuanli's murderous figure, the captains of the Wang family looked at each other with helpless faces, but at the same time at a loss.
After more than a month, they became more and more sure of one thing.
That is, the elder is probably crazy.
Although it is indeed very regrettable that a Tianyin Juehuang Body that was easily available could be missed in vain, but it would not stimulate the elder to such an extent, right?
People who enter the Black Mist Abyss will never come out alive. This is a truth that even a three-year-old child in Zhongzhou understands.
The elders have been staying here for a month, but they still don't give up and have no intention of taking them away.
If you keep guarding like this, when will the end come to an end?
The two captains couldn't help but stepped forward and said cautiously: "Elder, how about we... withdraw?"
"Yes, we have been guarding here for a month. Even if those two people are really capable of escaping from the black mist abyss, after a whole month has passed, they must have been corroded by the black mist to the point where no bones are left. No matter how long we stay here, there is no point..."
Wang Xuanru seemed to have not heard what the two of them said at all. His eyes were still staring at the black mist abyss below. Although his eyes were almost twisted, they revealed a sick persistence.
The premonition in his heart was very strong. He didn't care about Su Chen for the moment, but the Tianyin Juehuang Body, as a rare physique that had not been seen in thousands of years, would never die in the black mist abyss so easily.
What's more important is that, except for the Yuan Yin in Luo Xue'er's body, he may never be able to find a way to instantly break through three levels of Yuan Power in this life.
If he misses this opportunity, he will really be trapped in the realm of the seventh-level Martial Saint for the rest of his life, and there will be no chance of reaching the realm of the Martial Emperor. How can Wang Xuanru be willing to give up?
…
Su Chen put Xue'er into the Tianji Baoyu space, and immediately used his Yuan Power to perform the "Hidden Shadow Hidden Dragon Technique", instantly causing his appearance, body and aura to undergo earth-shaking changes.
Wang Xuanli and the captains of the Wang family all know the secret of Luo Xueer's Tianyin Juehuang body.
Therefore, in order to protect Xue'er and to protect themselves, they must die.
However, Su Chen also understood that he could never use his identity to kill these people.
The top forces in Zhongzhou have a special way of transmitting information called soul cards. As the elder of the royal family, Wang Xuanli must also have other means besides soul cards.
Now, in order to take Luo Xue'er as his own, Wang Xuanli definitely did not tell the Wang family the secret that Luo Xue'er possessed the Heavenly Yin Juehuang Body.
However, if he rushes out with his true identity to kill them, it will be even more troublesome once they pass the message back.
Su Chen didn't know who to pretend to be for a moment, so he simply disguised himself as Ren Tianjue before, and pretended to be an eighth-level martial saint.
After confirming that the disguise was flawless, he rushed towards where everyone in the Wang family was, with an awe-inspiring murderous intent in his eyes.
"Huh? Someone is coming!"
Su Chen "Eighth Level Martial Saint"
The momentum completely exploded and flew quickly, which of course attracted the attention of Wang Xuanru and others.
"The aura is so strong, he is an eighth-level martial saint!"
